prerequisites.required: Basic computer navigation and internet skills

system_requirements.hardware: Any device with a modern web browser

overview.positioning: Master the cloud-first productivity suite that powers modern startups and remote teams.
overview.short_description: Learn to collaborate in real-time using Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Meet.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Co-author documents and spreadsheets in real-time
Organize and share files securely using Google Drive
Manage complex schedules with Google Calendar
Host and manage virtual meetings via Google Meet

why_now.industry_shift: Startups and remote-first companies default to Google Workspace over traditional desktop software.
why_now.ai_impact: Understanding the core cloud infrastructure is necessary before adopting AI tools like Gemini.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for workers who can operate smoothly in a browser-based, collaborative environment.
why_now.career_opportunity: Essential for entering tech, startup, or freelance ecosystems.

learning_outcomes: COLLABORATE: Edit documents simultaneously with team members
ORGANIZE: Cloud file structures with proper permissions
COMMUNICATE: Efficiently via Gmail, Calendar, and Meet
ANALYZE: Basic data sets using Google Sheets

stages.name: Schedule
stages.desc: Setting up a sync in Calendar

stages.name: Co-Author
stages.desc: Drafting the plan live in Google Docs

stages.name: Share
stages.desc: Distributing the final link via Drive

business_use_cases.business_problem: Version control issues with emailed document attachments
business_use_cases.approach: Migrate all documents to Google Drive and use link-sharing with permissions
business_use_cases.output: Single Source of Truth Cloud Drive

ai_integration.validation_protocol: Checking sharing permissions before sending links
ai_integration.responsible_use: Ensuring sensitive data is not shared publicly

best_practices: Share links, never download and attach files to emails
Use 'Suggesting' mode in Docs instead of direct editing for reviews
Organize Drive with clear naming conventions

common_mistakes.professional_approach: Default to 'Viewer' or 'Commenter' unless active editing is required

career_paths.employer_expectations: Seamless ability to work in a browser and manage links/permissions
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A fully organized and shared team workspace

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Gain access -> Organize Drive -> Manage Calendar -> Collaborate on Docs
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Demonstrated understanding of permissions (via interview or sample drive links)

what_you_will_build: A Structured Google Drive Team Folder
A Collaborative Project Plan in Docs/Sheets
final_deliverables: A shared portfolio folder containing formatted docs, sheets, and presentations with correct permissions.

assessment.criteria: Correct folder structure, accurate permission settings, and collaborative tool usage

certification.title: Google Workspace Proficiency
certification.criteria: Pass the final workspace setup project

not_covered: Google Workspace Admin Console (Enterprise IT setup), Google Apps Script

faq.question: Is this different from regular Gmail?
faq.answer: The tools are the same, but we teach the professional, collaborative workflows used in businesses.

faq.question: Do I need to pay for Google Workspace?
faq.answer: No, all exercises can be completed with a free personal Google account.

lessons.what_learner_does: Schedules a team meeting with a video link

lessons.what_is_taught: Folder structures, search operators, and offline access
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a logical team folder hierarchy

lessons.what_is_taught: Viewer, Commenter, Editor roles and link sharing
lessons.what_learner_does: Shares specific files with varied permission levels

modules.hands_on_practice: Organizing files and setting up meetings

modules.module_purpose: Create and co-author documents, spreadsheets, and presentations

lessons.why_it_matters: Replaces emailing document versions back and forth

lessons.what_is_taught: Basic formulas, data validation, and filter views
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows multiple people to track data simultaneously
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a shared team task tracker
Designs a brief project update presentation

modules.hands_on_practice: Creating and linking various document types
